Title: General availability: Azure Database for PostgreSQL

Body.Content:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL is now generally available. This service brings to Azure the community versions of the PostgreSQL database engine.

Azure Database for PostgreSQL offers built-in high availability, elastic scaling for performance, and industry-leading security and compliance, with an SLA of 99.99 percent.

Azure Database for PostgreSQL gives you flexibility in your apps. From your choice of framework and language, to a rich ecosystem of tools and services, Azure Database for PostgreSQL makes it easier for you to build intelligent apps faster.

For details, see the Azure Database for PostgreSQL general availability blog post.

Learn more about regional availability.

Learn more about Azure Database for PostgreSQL.
